# EssenTechs - Home Appliance Repair Services

> Trusted appliance repair service provider in Kochi, Ernakulam, Kerala (Pincode: 682021).

## About EssenTechs
EssenTechs provides doorstep repair, maintenance, and installation services for major home appliances across Kochi and the greater Ernakulam district.

- **Address**: Civil Line Kakkanad - Kunneparambu Road, Office No. KRA-52, Kochi, Kerala 682021
- **Phone**: +91 97467 00889
- **Email**: info@essentechs.com
- **Website**: https://essentechs.com

## Services Offered
- **Washing Machine Repair**: Front load, top load, semi-automatic & fully-automatic repairs for Samsung, LG, IFB, Whirlpool, Bosch.
- **Refrigerator Repair**: Single door, double door, side-by-side, inverter compressor issues, gas charging, cooling faults.
- **Air Conditioner (AC) Repair & Service**: Split AC, inverter AC, gas refilling, cooling coil repair, jet cleaning, PCB repair.
- **Microwave Oven Repair**: Solo, grill, and convection microwave magnetron replacement, heating issue fixes.
- **Television (TV) Repair**: LED, LCD, OLED, 4K Smart TVs display panel replacement, sound repair, motherboard service.

## Service Coverage Areas in Kerala
Kakkanad, Edapally, Aluva, Palarivattom, Vyttila, Kalamassery, Thrikkakara, Kaloor, Fort Kochi, Tripunithura, and all of Ernakulam.
